review_candidates.title: E/E System Architect – Vehicle Architecture
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an E/E System Architect – Vehicle Architecture based in Spain. Take the lead in shaping next-generation vehicle electrical and electronic (E/E) architectures within a multidisciplinary engineering environment. In this role, you will translate functional, technical, and regulatory requirements into robust vehicle-level systems and detailed architectural designs. You will work across ECUs, embedded software, sensors, actuators, and vehicle communication networks to ensure seamless system integration. Collaborating with engineering teams, suppliers, and technology partners, you will help deliver consistent, reliable, and scalable vehicle architectures. You will also contribute to system validation, technical reviews, and continuous improvements throughout the development lifecycle. This opportunity combines advanced automotive engineering, systems architecture, and cross-functional collaboration to support the development of innovative vehicle technologies. Accountabilities You will be responsible for defining and maintaining vehicle-level E/E architectures, ensuring that system requirements, interfaces, and communication concepts align with technical and regulatory expectations. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, you will support the integration, validation, and continuous improvement of complex vehicle systems. Design and develop vehicle-level E/E architectures based on functional, technical, and regulatory requirements. Translate vehicle requirements into system-, subsystem-, ECU-, and component-level specifications. Define and maintain system architectures, interfaces, signal flows, and communication concepts. Design and assess vehicle communication networks, including CAN, CAN-FD, LIN, Automotive Ethernet, and diagnostic systems. Coordinate the integration of ECUs, sensors, actuators, and software components across vehicle domains. Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, suppliers, and technology partners to ensure architectural consistency. Participate in architecture reviews, system integration activities, testing, and technical troubleshooting. Conduct change impact assessments and evaluate the effects of modifications on vehicle-level systems. Maintain requirements traceability and ensure consistency across the complete vehicle architecture. Support engineering development processes and contribute to continuous improvements in system design and integration. Requirements The ideal candidate combines a strong engineering background with hands-on experience in automotive E/E systems, systems architecture, and requirements engineering. You should be comfortable managing complex technical interfaces, working with multidisciplinary teams, and applying relevant automotive standards and development methodologies. Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics, Automotive Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline. Several years of experience in E/E systems development within the automotive or off-highway industry. Strong understanding of vehicle E/E architectures, systems engineering, and requirements engineering. Familiarity with automotive communication technologies, including CAN/CAN-FD, LIN, Automotive Ethernet, and UDS diagnostics. Experience with architecture and requirements management tools such as PREEvision, DOORS, Enterprise Architect, MATLAB/Simulink, or comparable MBSE/SysML-based solutions. Knowledge of automotive development standards and processes, including ISO 26262 and Automotive SPICE; familiarity with ISO/SAE 21434 is an advantage. Understanding of ECU hardware, embedded software, wiring harnesses, and vehicle electrical architectures. Experience collaborating with suppliers, development partners, and cross-functional engineering teams. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills. Excellent English communication skills; German proficiency is an advantage. Benefits Starting salary of €4,300 gross per month, based on a 38.5-hour working week, with higher compensation considered depending on qualifications and professional experience. Permanent employment contract. Flexible working hours and the possibility of mobile working. Career development and talent management opportunities. Corporate benefits and employee events. Opportunity to work on innovative automotive engineering projects. Collaborative, multidisciplinary working environment. Commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities. review_candidates.title: Consultor de software
review_candidates.description: Tu principal desafío será la consecución de la integración completa de soluciones SaaS EDI, de facturación electrónica y cumplimiento tributario (VAT Compliance, eReporting, etc.). Al situar nuestro servicio de consultoría técnica en el centro, participarás en todas las fases del proyecto de integración: desde la valoración de las tareas recibidas a través de Dirección de Proyectos y coordinadas por la Dirección de Equipos, la discusión de las mismas en los Daily Scrum, la ejecución de las tareas planificadas, formación y soporte al cliente. ¿Cómo superar el reto? Tu primer paso en EDICOM será participar de un curso de especialización de seis semanas aproximadamente a tiempo completo, desde la que te enseñaremos todo sobre SaaS EDI, facturación electrónica y cumplimiento tributario. Una vez tengas acotado el sprint y dispongas de tus tareas definidas, valoradas y asignadas en tu backlog, podrás gestionar tu tiempo para llegar a lo planificado. Tus tareas serán la automatización de las conversiones de formatos ERP (IDOC, csv, XML, JSON, etc) del emisor a otros formatos estándar (EDIFACT, ODETTE, X12, VDA, Peppol, XML UBL) para su integración según el formato ERP del receptor. Para ello: Ante necesidades y con cierta experiencia podrás realizar desarrollos a medida (informes), analizarás sus necesidades y te ocuparás de su desarrollo. Asimismo, tomarás y trasladarás los requerimientos de nuevas pantallas al área de I+D (Investigación y Desarrollo) para que desarrolle estas nuevas funcionalidades. Parametrizarás el SaaS EDI al cliente para la correcta adecuación del proyecto. Parametrizarás los distintos protocolos de comunicación segura (API, AS2, Web Service, RESTFul, Adaptador Java, SFTP, OFTP2, etc.). para el envío de información entre empresas. Realizarás test de comunicaciones. Según proyectos y por los requisitos del cliente, programarás en JavaScript para adecuarnos al modelo de integración que necesite el cliente. Con el tiempo, asesorarás y generarás propuestas de integración adaptadas al formato del cliente. Serás tú quien decidas qué hacer y cuándo dentro del Sprint. Programarás la transformación entre los distintos formatos de datos entre el ERP del cliente y estándar del destino. Te ocuparás de la fase de testeo (test funcionales) antes de su puesta en marcha. Capacitarás y darás soporte técnico al cliente. Llevarás la puesta en producción y fase de estabilización. Te acompañaremos realizando tutorizaciones recurrentes y continuas, cada tres meses durante el primer año, para que te sientas guiado. Qué buscamos en ti: Grado en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Geodesia, Matemáticas, Física con habilidades en TI y programación. Técnico Superior en Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Multiplataformas y Técnico Superior en Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Web. Se valora experiencia previa en las tecnologías requeridas y en las responsabilidades definidas, así como recién titulados o candidaturas de estudiantes de últimos años de grado que busquen estabilidad y carrera profesional. Persona con gran capacidad de trabajo y disciplinada. Facilidad de comunicación, resolutiva y trato agradable. Buen nivel de inglés (mínimo B2). Valoramos italiano, portugués, francés, turco, árabe, holandés, alemán o polaco. Se valorará expedientes académicos y/o posibles experiencias profesionales. Permiso de trabajo a jornada completa en España. Qué te ofrecemos: Formarás parte de equipos técnicos internacionales de primer nivel y participarás en proyectos de todo el mundo donde tendrás la oportunidad de hacer que tus idiomas extranjeros sean una herramienta fundamental en tu día a día. Participarás en proyectos internacionales donde podrás llevar tu perfil como consultor técnico a un nivel internacional. Desde un primer momento, podrás proponer e innovar en todas las fases del proyecto de implementación, gracias a las metodologías ágiles y la eficiente comunicación entre departamentos y equipos de la que disfrutamos en EDICOM. Dispondrás de KPIs de productividad que medirán tu valía y proyectarán tu carrera profesional. Quedará a tu alcance una carrera profesional definida y clara desde la que podrás acceder a posiciones como Project Manager, Team Manager, Technical Key Account Manager, etc. Si te atrae el desafío y crees que puedes llevar nuestra estrategia de crecimiento a otro nivel, inscríbete en la oferta y conoce a EDICOM

review_candidates.title: Brand Manager, EMEA | Foot & Ankle
review_candidates.description: The Job’s Mission: As Brand Manager for Stryker’s Foot & Ankle business, you will drive market share growth through the formulation and execution of effective, strategic, marketing plans. You are the EMEA brand expert who sets strategic direction and ensures execution for portfolio growth through the development of marketing campaigns and strategies, portfolio development as well as internal and external education strategies. Our product portfolio includes innovative solutions such as Total Ankle Replacement and implants for hindfoot and forefoot surgery, designed to improve patient and hospital outcomes. As a leader in Foot & Ankle surgery, Stryker offers comprehensive solutions for individuals with chronic pain. Find out more via: https://www.stryker.com/us/en/portfolios/orthopaedics/foot-and-ankle.html In this position, you will own the creation of compelling customer value propositions, maximize new product launches and enhance key customer relationships across EMEA. You will work closely with local Marketing teams in leading downstream execution while also contributing to upstream marketing initiatives to ensure development projects address EMEA customer needs appropriately. Reporting to the Marketing Director of Extremities EMEA, this role can be based in any of our European locations : we offer great workplace flexibility with a hybrid work model. This is an exciting opportunity to join one of the world's leading medical technology organizations in our mission of making healthcare better! What you will do: In your new role, you will start with a familiarization phase to learn about our portfolio and build relationships with internal/external stakeholders. In alignment with global strategy, set annual and long-range brand/indications strategy to achieve required growth, profit and market share targets. Create/distribute scalable assets, tools, marketing campaigns and best practices which can be localized for maximum impact. Identify education and brand experience opportunities for both internal and external audiences to increase brand perception and value in collaboration with Education Manager. Develop trust and strong relationships with local marketers, sales professionals, internal stakeholders and key customers. In collaboration with the Divisional/Portfolio Marketing/Local Marketing teams, you will create the Annual Marketing Plan for EMEA and portfolio roadmap over a 3-5 year horizon. Work with country leadership to forecast demand and partner with supply chain accordingly. Define and execute regional product life cycle including phase-in (launch) and phase-out of products. Provide analysis of business performance, brand perception and other drivers of future brand performance. Define mitigating actions to deliver on strategy. Partner with divisional resources to develop portfolio through new product development, line extensions and M&A activity. Work in partnership with local Product Managers in a complex matrix organization, influencing and ensuring execution of the EMEA-wide strategies. Create EMEA-wide, scalable, customer engagement events such as facility tours/events/congresses, hands-on opportunities, etc. Manage branding, messaging, positioning and pricing of assigned brands based on market, customer and competitive insights. Lead the commercialization planning of new product development in partnership with Portfolio teams. Take the lead in developing Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) for the brand. Travel percentage: 40%, as this position involves customer-facing activities and sales support in the field. What you need: Required: Bachelor’s degree is required. 8+ years of work experience is required, including experience in fields such as international Marketing, Product/Brand Management or related in industries such as MedTech, BioTech, etc. Ability to accurately and effectively lead/manage (marketing) projects to ensure timely outcomes, business performance and growth. Excellent interpersonal communications, persuasion and presentation skills – with proficiency in spoken and written English. Strong strategic-thinking, adaptability, analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and to also establish relationships/work in collaboration with others. Demonstrated ability to relate to stakeholders and customers from different markets and cultures. Ability to understand and work within complex interdivisional procedures and policies. Impeccable work ethics & integrity in managing confidential information. Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word & PowerPoint). Preferred: Experience in Orthopaedics would be highly preferred. MBA is preferred. What we offer: Flat hierarchies and a culture committed to achieve our mission and deliver remarkable results. We grow talent: we offer great personal and internal career development for our employees, with the possibility to make both vertical and lateral position movement. An attractive salary and benefits package. Recognition of your performance: at Stryker, outstanding individual and cross-functional team performance is rewarded. Ideas, projects, or other exceptional achievements can be submitted for various awards on a local and global level. Collaborative and inclusive environment: join a team that values diversity and inclusion, fostering a supportive and innovative workplace. Quality products that improve the lives of our customers and patients. Ability to discover your strengths, follow your passion and own your career. Netherlands Pay Ranges: Netherlands: €71.800 - €133.400 EUR Annual Belgium Pay Ranges: Belgium: €83.000 - €138.200 EUR Annual Germany Pay Ranges: Berlin/Duisburg/Waghäusel/field-based 40Std: €84.400 - €140.600 EUR Annual Spain Pay Ranges: Spain: €59.000 - €98.300 EUR Annual United Kingdom Pay Ranges: United Kingdom: £62,900 - £104,800 GBP Annual Italy Pay Ranges: Italy: €58.100 - €96.800 EUR Annual Sweden Pay Ranges: Sweden: kr694.000 - kr1.158.000 SEK Annual Chez Stryker, nous pensons que la transparence aide les candidats à prendre des décisions éclairées concernant la prochaine étape de leur carrière. La rémunération constitue un élément important de ce processus et nous souhaitons expliquer clairement comment elle est déterminée. Les informations de rémunération publiées pour ce poste peuvent être présentées sous la forme d’une fourchette salariale ou d’un montant fixe, selon le poste concerné. En plus du salaire de base, ce poste peut donner droit à une rémunération variable (telle qu’une prime et/ou des commissions, le cas échéant), ainsi qu’au programme complet d’avantages sociaux de Stryker. Si vous souhaitez en savoir plus sur le salaire ou les avantages associés à ce poste, votre recruteur ou votre recruteuse se fera un plaisir de vous en expliquer les détails au fur et à mesure de votre progression dans le processus de recrutement. Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually. LI-Additional
